Backlog evidence committed at MitMi e8369cf9. No RPC invocation, production writes, or deployment.
blocker: The confirmed Local Match fix and Trip repair are not deployed to production; no production rollout is authorized in this run. Trip leave's reported runtime failure remains unreproduced, so do not claim it is fixed or apply migrations without explicit approval and backup/PITR confirmation.
